Core services

Request an appointment

  • Maintenance & service

    Scheduled upkeep planned around your vehicle and the way you drive it.

  • Diagnostics & repair

    A warning light, a new sound or a change in how it drives. We start with a diagnostic plan before any repair decision.

  • Brakes & suspension

    Braking concerns, uneven tire wear, ride quality, steering and handling.

  • Cooling & air conditioning

    Houston heat is hard on cooling systems. Overheating, coolant leaks, temperature warnings or A/C that isn’t as cold as it should be.

  • Pre-purchase inspection

    Know the car before you buy it, with an inspection focused on condition and service needs.

Questions

What vehicles do you service?

European makes including Porsche, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi and the other brands listed above.

Can I request a pre-purchase inspection?

Yes. Choose Pre-purchase inspection and tell us about the car you’re considering.

What should I include with my request?

Your car’s make and model, what you’re noticing, and any preferred days.

Does submitting reserve an appointment?

No. Your request goes to the shop, and a person will contact you to confirm availability.
